sections.title: key findings — updated after W10 (regular season complete)

insights.content: DTC #1 closes the regular season 7-3. W10 (5/30) beat DTC #3 3-2: Lobato won S2 6-3 6-1, Hernandez/Kiyono took D1 6-4 6-2, Allen/Drees closed D3 with a walkover. Shi dropped S1 to Witherspoon (DTC #3) 7-5 6-3, and Paull/Waters dropped D2. The 3-2 result held — DTC #1 took the matches they needed to and finished on the right side of a close one.

Red Rock CC #2 wins 3.5B — finishing 10-0 after today's match vs DTC #3. Dragonridge (7-2) also plays today vs Desert Palm. DTC #1 is done at 7-3. If Dragonridge wins today, DTC #1 is 3rd seed from Sub B. If Dragonridge loses, DTC #1 ties at 7-3 and the tiebreak (individual line record) decides 2nd place. Dragonridge is heavily favored vs Desert Palm.
DTC #2 wins 3.5A at 9-1 — convincing. LTF finishes 2nd at 7-3. Summerlin is 3rd at 6-4. DTC #2 enters playoffs as a strong 1st seed from Sub A and will be the team to beat across both subflights.

Stacie Corelle (bl=3.41, r=3.51, 6-1) is the backbone of DTC #1 — the only player with both a high rating and a dominant record. Karen Kiyono (bl=3.33, r=3.41, 6-2) is the biggest riser on the team and quietly the most reliable doubles player. Together Hernandez/Kiyono at D1 went 5-3 this season, winning the line in W10's decisive match.

Amy Waters (bl=3.66, r=3.43, 3-3) is down 0.23 from her ceiling — the biggest drop on the team. She's lost D1 or D2 in all three of DTC #1's losses and dropped D2 again in W10. Allen (bl=3.68, r=3.57, 4-1) and Drees (bl=3.57, r=3.62, 4-2) are both playing above baseline. Waters needs to rediscover her game before playoffs, or the D1 slot may need a different partner.

Shi Oskooi is 2-2 at 3.5 S1 (r=3.20, bl=2.74). She wins the winnable matches but has lost to the stronger players — Witherspoon (DTC #3) in W10, and presumably one early loss. At 3.5, the S1 field is meaningfully stronger than 3.0A. She's not the same lock she is in 3.0.

sections.title: playoff outlook — DTC #1 likely 3rd seed from 3.5B

insights.content: DTC #1 enters playoffs at 7-3 — 3rd seed from 3.5B if Dragonridge wins today (likely), 2nd if they don't. Either way, DTC #1 avoided the bottom half of the bracket and has the wins to justify a deep run. Red Rock CC #2 (10-0) is the clear top seed and the team to avoid until the final.

Lead with Corelle at S1 — 6-1 is the best record on the team and she's battle-tested. Allen/Drees at D1 gives the best individual ratings. Kiyono in every doubles lineup she can play — she's been the most consistent player on the roster. Consider pairing Waters with a steadier partner at D2 rather than putting her under pressure at D1.

If DTC #1 meets DTC #2 (9-1, 3.5A winner), that's the hardest possible draw. DTC #2's roster has three players rated 3.49+ (Lobato, Paull, Corelle equivalents). DTC #1 has beaten DTC #2 before, but not with DTC #2 running at full form as a 1-seed. Win D1 and find a split in singles — that's the path.
